about_the_game:
Kinetic Neo Ornate Bout is a twin-stick competition designed for local multiplayer with 1v1 and 2v2 matches.

You will

play the Ball Game to score points [left stick]

while you 

play the Minigames to gain abilities [right stick] and activate them [Buttons]

while you 

push Void Snails towards your opponent to unleash CHAOS!!! [left stick + right stick]

Take your multitasking skills to new heights and become the goddess of K.N.O.B.

Abilitites

Four abilities (each with a regular and power version) mess up physics and visibility.

Quick Infos:

  • Green Flip Boards? Yes they follow a strict rule and even in the power version it is predictable which Ball is the fake clone

  • Blue walls tell the truth, pink walls always tell the opposite.

  • Yellow speeds up the Ball. In a 2v2 match the teammate controlling abilities aims the power version!

  • Pink will send the Ball to the Void only being visible close to important structures and through void gates opened by Pink Snails. Power Pink will even send your opponents Paddle to the Void!

Void Snails

Void Snails manipulate the arena even further! Generally they become more dangerous the closer they are and once they've reached your base you're in big trouble!

Once a Void Snail is in your base beware that

  • the green will flip left and right stick! Welcome to hell.

  • the blue will,.. nevermind. We wish you good luck defending the blue ability while a blue Void Snail lingers in your base!

  • the yellow will make you smaller while the one that mother gives you... jk. Just smaller, as long as it's in your base

  • the pink will grant you insights to the Void! Okay, it will cover everything else but hey: if you are in the Void as well you can see yourself. Note that the Pink Void Snail may also cover important parts of Layergames.

Team Play

Kinetic Neo Ornate Bout is extra hard with a steep learning curve. So if handling the Ball, activating abilities, playing Layergames and pushing Void Snails at the same time seems too hard, try playing 2v2 where each teammate takes control over two tasks. But which teammate controls which tasks is shuffeling frequently... of course. 

What comes after the demo?

  • 6 Minigames (currently 3 unlocked)

  • Tournaments in three modes for 8+ players

  • Actual bots with different strengths and weaknesses (in the demo you play against some questionable dummies)

  • Training Area (for now you will have to test around a bit how everything works)

  • Singleplayer Highscore Challenges

  • More Music Tracks!

  • Achievements

short_description: Play two games at the same time—each with one stick of your controller. Score points, gain abilities, and don't forget to push the snails towards your opponent! They are the third and final dread in this extra hard multitasking challenge. K.N.O.B. will melt your brain! Play local with friends.
